claims.claim: Identity and current reporting lineage are reproducible through SEC CIK 0001807794 and accession 0001628280-26-060111, filed 2026-09-02 for period 2026-08-01.

The current 10-Q is the controlling primary origin for quarterly financial, concentration and liquidity evidence; issuer IR material is retained as a separate origin for product events and is not counted as independent corroboration of SEC financial facts.
Prior fiscal-2026 10-K evidence remains valid cumulative lineage for annual trajectory and ATM history, but current-quarter values defer to the newer 10-Q.

factors.name: Data Confidence
factors.basis: Current SEC filing plus cumulative annual filing provide direct primary lineage; duplicate SEC document/index origins collapse to one filing origin.

factors.name: Evidence freshness
factors.basis: Quarterly filing dated 2026-09-02 is current for this work cycle.

unknowns.unknown: Issuer product announcements are management-origin claims and require realized filing evidence before being treated as shipment/share proof.

claims.claim: Realized operating trajectory is strong: fiscal 2026 revenue was approximately $1.3B versus $436.8M in fiscal 2025, with fiscal-2026 net income $472.3M; the quarter ended 2026-08-01 produced $479.0M revenue and $129.4M net income.

Customer concentration is a material resilience risk rather than an unresolved evidence gap: fiscal-2026 top-10 customers represented about 90% of revenue, and the latest quarter's two largest customers represented 71% of quarterly revenue as documented in the current filing lineage.

Liquidity/runway evidence is sufficient for reproducible treatment: fiscal year-end cash and equivalents were about $1.2B and working capital $1.8B; management stated existing liquidity was sufficient for at least twelve months and longer term. Fiscal 2026 also included $736.3M net ATM proceeds from 4.8M ordinary shares, making dilution history explicit rather than unknown.

Share-based compensation remains economically material: the latest quarter reports $87.979M of share-based compensation on $479.003M revenue; this is a dilution/capital-allocation risk to carry explicitly rather than a blocker.

DustPhotonics acquisition and optical expansion increase product optionality but also consume capital and create integration/qualification risk; launch/TAM claims are not treated as realized revenue evidence.

factors.name: Execution / operating trajectory
factors.basis: Large realized year-over-year revenue and earnings expansion persists into the latest quarter.

factors.name: Balance sheet / survival
factors.basis: Substantial cash/working capital and explicit at-least-12-month liquidity statement.

factors.name: Dilution / capital allocation
factors.basis: Material fiscal-2026 ATM issuance and high current share-based compensation must be carried in risk treatment.

factors.name: Customer concentration
factors.basis: Revenue remains highly concentrated despite expanding customer engagement.

factors.name: Moat / pricing power
factors.basis: Proprietary SerDes/DSP and tailored-to-broadly-reusable product model support differentiation, but filing evidence does not establish durable pricing power independently of customer concentration.

risks.risk: Hyperscaler/customer concentration creates step-function revenue and bargaining-power exposure.
ATM issuance and material SBC can dilute owners even while operating results improve.
DustPhotonics integration and optical qualification can consume capital without delivering expected economics.

contradictions.claim: Rapid realized growth coexists with severe customer concentration and meaningful equity issuance.
contradictions.resolution: Both are primary-supported and should be represented simultaneously in factor/risk treatment; neither invalidates the other.

unknowns.unknown: Long-run customer diversification pace remains uncertain.
Future optical product qualification/share and acquisition synergies are not yet realized filing facts.
Durable standalone pricing power is not directly quantified in the filing evidence.
